test_item_verbatim: - IF the LTM does not receive the signal TRANSM2.ShiftLeverPosition, LTM shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition equal to "SNA".

tcs.tc_title: ShiftLeverPosition = SNA when ShiftLeverPosition is missing, stop the CAN message and read vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Stop transmitting STATUS_CCAN5 on the bus
2. Read vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition and check that it is SNA
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN5 is no longer received by the LTM
2. vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition = SNA is sent over LVDS
tcs.split_reason: ShiftLeverPosition = SNA when ShiftLeverPosition is missing
tcs.test_item:
- IF the LTM does not receive the signal TRANSM2.ShiftLeverPosition, LTM shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition equal to "SNA".

(ShiftLeverPosition = SNA when ShiftLeverPosition is missing, stop the CAN message and read vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V42-308` 之「LTM 未收到 `TRANSM2` 時，LVDS 側送 `SNA`」。**`TRANSM2` 不在 `forms/` 四本 DBC**（A-CA23／DR-CAM-f）；停送之動作不需知其 raw，ER 仍可判。「訊號缺失」以**停送該 CAN 訊息**表達（下放包 §3）—— 逾時門檻之值於來源未載，**不造**（§8.4.1），ER 只判 SNA 之出現而不判其時限。依 R-CAM15(c)，V42 列承 637。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。**重掃依 profile §7.2 以訊號名自身為字串**（CAM-11 審閱 §二-1）：`ShiftLeverPosition` 於 `Project__637MCA_BH-CAN_R1_…dbc` 命中一處 —— `BO_ 998 STATUS_CCAN5`（`7|4@0+ (1,0) [0|15]`，`VAL_ … 1 "P" 2 "R" … 15 "SNA"`）。**來源之訊息名 `TRANSM2` 與 DBC 不同** —— test_item 上半之 verbatim 逐字不改（R-13）；procedure 與 ER 改以 DBC 之承載訊息 `STATUS_CCAN5`（`BO_ 998`）書寫，使該步可執行。`PENDING: DR-CAM-f` 因而**撤除**（CAM-11 審閱 §二-1）。（`TRANSM2` 之候選替代早已記於 DR-CAM-f 之 note，本輪以訊號名重掃予以確認。）
remarks: Source names the message TRANSM2; the DBC carries ShiftLeverPosition in STATUS_CCAN5 (BO_ 998). See DR-CAM-f.
